# Permai Polyclinics Fortuna

> 24-hour walk-in GP clinic in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia. Open every day including public holidays, no appointment needed. A doctor and a nurse are on duty at all hours.

- Address: Ground Floor, Lot 3 (DBKK No. 12) Block D2, Lorong Seroja 2, Fortuna Commercial Centre, Mile 2.5, Jalan Penampang, 88200 Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia
- Phone: 088-239 393 (+60 88 239 393). WhatsApp: 012-939 3537 (+60 12-939 3537)
- Email: info@permaipolyclinicsfortuna.com
- Resident doctor: Dr. Nicholas Jeremiah (Monash University, close to 13 years in medicine)
- Part of the Permai Polyclinics Group: https://www.permaipolyclinics.com/
- All prices are in Malaysian ringgit (RM) and do not include the doctor's consultation.

## Medical check-ups and health screening

Page: https://permaipolyclinicsfortuna.com/medical-check-up/ (Malay: https://permaipolyclinicsfortuna.com/ms/pemeriksaan-kesihatan/)

- Basic Health Screening: RM100 per person. Includes: Full blood count; Kidney function test; Liver function test; Fasting blood sugar; Cholesterol (lipid profile); HbA1c (average sugar over 3 months); Urine test (FEME).
- Full Health Screening: RM380 per person. Includes: Full blood count, blood group and ESR; Cholesterol profile, with hs-CRP and homocysteine; Kidney function, with eGFR; Liver function test; Blood sugar and HbA1c; Thyroid: TSH, free T4 and free T3; Hepatitis A and B; HIV, syphilis and rheumatoid factor; Cancer markers: AFP, CEA, breast and ovarian; Urine test (FEME).
- ECG heart check (Done in the clinic): RM50
- Urine test (FEME) (Infection, sugar and protein): RM20
- HbA1c (Average blood sugar over 3 months): RM30
- Ultrasound scan (Abdomen, and antenatal scans): RM50
- Thyroid screening (Basic thyroid check): RM100
- Thyroid full function test (With thyroid antibodies): RM150
- Full blood count (Haemoglobin, white cells and platelets): RM60
- Cholesterol (lipid profile) (Heart and blood vessel risk): RM30
- Blood sugar (Fasting or random): RM15
- Kidney function test (Salts, urea, creatinine and uric acid): RM36
- Liver function test: RM40
- Uric acid (Gout check): RM20
- Hepatitis B test (HBsAg): RM50
- HIV test (HIV 1 and 2): RM50
- PSA (Prostate check for men): RM60
- Vitamin D: RM150
- Dengue NS1 (Early dengue test): RM120
- Pregnancy test (Urine): RM20

Fast 10 to 12 hours before cholesterol and fasting blood sugar tests (plain water is fine). Blood is taken, and ECG and ultrasound are done, in the clinic. Pre-employment medicals and Haji and Umrah examinations are available, with employer and health forms completed.

## Vaccinations

Page: https://permaipolyclinicsfortuna.com/vaccinations/ (Malay: https://permaipolyclinicsfortuna.com/ms/vaksin/)

- Hepatitis B (Engerix-B): RM50, per dose, 3 doses over 6 months
- Flu shot (Influvac Tetra): RM80, 1 dose, every year
- Typhoid (Typhim Vi): RM120, 1 dose, lasts about 3 years
- Meningococcal (Haji and Umrah): RM200, 1 dose, protects for 5 years
- Pneumococcal (Pneumovax 23): RM200, 1 dose
- Tetanus booster: RM25, 1 dose, every 10 years
- 6-in-1 vaccine (Hexaxim): RM175, per dose, on your baby's schedule
- MMR (Priorix): RM88, per dose, on your child's schedule

Prices are per dose. Some vaccines are ordered in, so WhatsApp the clinic first to check stock. Vaccinations are recorded in the MySejahtera app and in the vaccine card or child's health book.
